description: Find files in a workspace when you don't know their exact ID. Pick a `mode`: "text" runs a full-text search over file contents and titles; "tags" returns files carrying ALL of the given tagIds (AND logic); "files" matches by partial file name/title. Reach for search before `get` when you only know roughly what you want; use `list` with type=files instead when you just need everything in a library. Optionally narrow to one library with libraryId.

libraryId.description: Limit search to a specific library

mode.description: text: full-text search; tags: find files matching ALL specified tags (AND logic); files: find files by partial name/title match

name: search
